resolved_conflicts.explanation: Earlier structures on the site were the 1912 camp lookout, the 1918 platform tower and cabin, and the 1933 wooden tower. The 1948 steel tower is the current structure that the register records.

notes_for_editor: Unresolved conflicts left for a human: (1) steel tower year, 1948 in the register, firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts versus a 1949 annual report entry (quoted on Forest Lookouts), which the story reports as a disagreement; (2) tower origin, army or WWII surplus versus 'designed for the U.S. Air Forces' in the 1958 report; (3) cab, 7x7 metal cab in the register versus a 14x14 cabin midway up in the 1958 caption, which may describe the 1933 live-in cab; (4) status, 'active' in the register versus emergency status on two sites. Record design was null and is filled from the register. No source read says whether the public may visit; the association homepage does not mention public visits. No new photos.
